articles.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
articles.description: AMD announced today that it's acquiring World Labs, an AI research lab co-founded by the prominent researcher Dr. Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock deal worth approximately $8.2 billion.
